newsitem.title: USA: Silver King to acquire Home Shopping.
newsitem.headline: Silver King to acquire Home Shopping.

text.p: Silver King Communications Inc said Monday it agreed to acquire Home Shopping Network in exchange for stock.

Silver King said the proposed merger would reunify the two companies which split in 1992 and supercedes the company's previous agreement to purchase only Liberty Media Corp's controlling interest in Home Shopping.
The proposal calls for Liberty Media to retain a 19.9 percent Home Shopping interest to avoid owning more than a 21.37 percent equity interest in Silver King, its statement said.

Silver King said it will exchange 0.45 common share for each Home Shopping common share and 0.54 Class B share for each Home Shopping Class B share, which has 10 votes and is held solely by Liberty Media.
Libery Media would receive a premium of 10.67 percent on its aggregate holdings of Home Shopping common and Class B shares, Silver King said.

Completion of the merger is subject to approval by Home Shopping and Silver King shareholders, it said. Home Shopping holder approval will include the majority decision of those voting excluding Liberty Media.
